manifest.name: dsh-grok-kit
manifest.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin: Grok OAuth, fused web/X search, Imagine image generation and editing, experimental video generation, and session media cards.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsdown && node scripts/wrap-client.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

bundle.text:
# Optional SuperGrok / X Premium route over the base composition.
# A saved agent-default-model setting still wins over this bundle value.

- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: xai-oauth
    model: grok-4.6

- insert:
    - id: dsh-grok-kit
      name: dsh-grok-kit
      config:
        # Main-request server-side web/X search is opt-in now (2026-08-25):
        # reliable most of the time, but occasional odd failures. Enable it
        # from Settings -> xAI Grok -> Search & feature options when needed.
        # DSH native function web_search is stripped from the payload to avoid
        # HTTP 400 Duplicate tool names: web_search.
        backendSearch: false
        # grok_imagine_edit (image-to-image, POST /v1/images/edits), merged
        # from the former dsh-grok-imagine-edit plugin. editModel: '' follows
        # the live catalog
        # (grok-imagine-image-2.0, fallback grok-imagine-image).
        # All media is off until explicitly selected after risk confirmation.
        # See README/VIDEO before setting mediaRiskAcknowledged in advanced config.
        imagineTool: false
        editTool: false
        videoTool: false
        mediaRiskAcknowledged: false

readme.text: **中文** · [English](README.en.md)
> 通过 OAuth 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 Grok：主循环融合网页与 X 搜索、多轮推理衔接、图片生成与编辑、视频生成（实验性），以及仅作用于 xAI 的独立代理。
`dsh-grok-kit` 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 增加独立的 `xai-oauth` 路由。它不要求 `XAI_API_KEY`，也不修改 dsh 源码；重点不只是“能登录”，而是把服务端搜索和连续 reasoning 所需的请求字段接进主聊天路径。

- **搜索融入主循环：** 网页与 X 检索发生在 Grok 的同一轮 Think 中，推理可以直接使用刚搜到的材料
- **多轮推理衔接：** 默认使用 high effort，并保留 `reasoning.encrypted_content`，让后续回合能够带回加密推理上下文
- **登录状态与 Grok CLI 同步：** 直接共用并回写 `~/.grok/auth.json`，不是只复制一次后各自轮换 refresh token
- **图片生成与编辑（实验性）：** `grok_imagine` 文生图、`grok_imagine_edit` 图生图（复用主 OAuth session），默认关闭，在设置页确认风险后开启；非聊天模型不会混进对话模型列表
- **会话图片卡片：** 生成与编辑的结果保存在 DSH 附件库，在会话卡片里直接显示提示词、输入图与结果，支持下载与再次生成/编辑
- **视频生成（实验性）：** 单图生成视频，任务持久化、断线恢复与按账号隔离的下载；默认关闭，确认风险并重启 DSH 后开启
此外还包括 xAI 专用代理、聊天 401 强制刷新重试、凭据原子写入、能力状态页与诊断脱敏等支撑能力。
账号页的 **登录 Grok / X 订阅**共用官方 Grok OAuth，兼容 X Subscription 与原 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅；已登录时可重新授权以切换账号，不必先删除共享凭据。账号页也提供[官方订阅管理入口](<https://grok.com/dashboard>)。

额度使用官方 billing/settings 返回的百分比、周期、套餐及预付余额。REST 缺少使用百分比时会补查一次 gRPC；只有响应完整、状态成功且周期有效时，才按 proto3 隐式零值显示已用 0%／剩余 100%，不能核实时仍保留订阅详情、已用/剩余未知，不冒充无限额度。补查使用独立短超时，失败或补查超时不会抹去已读取的部分数据；整次读取超时、取消和账号校验仍然生效。结果按账号最多缓存 60 秒，已核实用量的缓存不跨有效周期，返回前也会重新校验周期；缺百分比的未缓存读取至多多发一次 gRPC 请求，REST 429 不触发补查。周期有效性依赖本机时钟，时钟偏差可能影响周期判断和隐式零值显示。统一计费标记来自接口，不根据套餐名猜测；仅展示当前登录身份，不汇总不同工作区或席位。本插件不提供 Cursor 登录或其他模型、外部 Agent 的接入。

**0.2.11** 适配 DSH 0.2.2 的原生设置侧栏图标，保留五页设置界面与按会话控制融合搜索的接口。账号处理与媒体风险确认规则不变；更新后重载插件或重启 DSH。

同一个模型 id，不代表不同接入方式一定有相同的使用体验。[xAI 官方说明 Grok Build 与公开 API 都提供 `grok-4.6`](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview)；真正影响搜索体验的，是服务端工具是否和主对话处在同一轮请求里。

**分离式搜索**会额外发起一轮模型请求完成检索或摘要，再把结果交回主对话。它仍然适合需要独立过滤条件的任务，但会多出一轮模型处理，而且搜索摘要不是在当前回复的 Think 中生成。

**主循环融合搜索**则按 [xAI Responses API 的服务端搜索方式](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/web-search)，把 `{type:web_search}` 与 `{type:x_search}` 直接放进主 Grok 请求。检索发生在 Think 里，模型能在同一轮推理中使用刚获得的网页和 X 材料；这条路径默认关闭（v0.1.8 起），可在设置页或配置中打开。

为让两类搜索共存，宿主原生 `web_search` 仍保留在 DSH 工具列表中，但会从启用融合搜索的 xAI payload 里移除，避免服务端工具重名；其他模型路由仍可照常使用宿主搜索。

从 0.2.10 起，接入插件可为各会话单独设置搜索开关，明确开启或关闭均可覆盖全局 `backendSearch`；未绑定的 DSH 会话仍使用全局配置。接入插件需支持此接口。

> 开启主循环搜索时，插件会剥掉 xAI 的 `x_keyword_search` 等收尾桩，避免 DSH 再开一轮并把同一篇正文再写一遍。这些名称若仍出现，属于故障诊断路径，不是正常用户体验。

需要按域名、账号或日期过滤时，改走独立的 `grok_web_search` / `x_search`（`backendSearch` 关闭时的默认路径）；开启 `backendSearch` 后这条独立路径退居可选。
`statefulResponses` 默认关闭。开启后，插件通过 `store: true` 和 `previous_response_id` 续接对话，只追加新的用户消息；若上一轮调用了 bash 等客户端工具，则不续接，以免重复生成已有的搜索正文。续接对话不保证缓存上一轮的全部搜索材料。

一次实际文生图结果：图片直接显示在会话卡片中，可查看大图、下载、复制图片、复制提示词或重新生成。

视频结果沿用同类卡片布局。图片生成、编辑和视频均为实验性能力，默认关闭，需在设置页确认风险后启用；实际可用性取决于账号资格与服务端限制。

readme.section: 设置页：账户、搜索与媒体
readme.text: 以下展示 0.2.10 的新版设置页，分为账户、模型、搜索、媒体和网络五页。
账户页集中展示订阅用量与余额，可手动刷新配额。图中数据是截图时该账号的状态，不代表所有账号的配额或套餐。
分别控制同一轮回答中的 Web / X 融合搜索与连续对话。两项均为实验性功能，默认关闭；图中融合搜索由用户手动开启。
图片开关同时控制生成与编辑，并显示两项实际状态；视频工具单独设置。媒体能力均为实验性功能，默认关闭，需确认风险后启用；视频还需重启 DSH，实际可用性取决于账号资格与服务端限制。
没有另起嵌套搜索工具卡片：网页检索直接发生在同一轮 Think 中，材料随即用于当前回复。截图里的新闻内容只用于展示交互，不作为事实来源。
桌面客户端和 Web 使用独立的插件安装与启用状态。请选择你实际使用的客户端；装到 Web profile 不会自动装到桌面端。

1. 打开桌面客户端，在侧栏进入 **插件（Plugins）→ 添加插件（Add plugin）**。
2. 输入 `dsh-grok-kit@latest` 并安装；需要固定本版时输入 `dsh-grok-kit@0.2.11`。
3. 安装完成后点击 **立即启用（Enable now）**。若提示需要重启，通过应用菜单或托盘的 **Quit / 退出** 完整退出后重新打开；仅关闭窗口可能只是隐藏应用。
4. 在 **设置 → xAI Grok** 中确认插件入口出现，再按账号资格完成登录。

此方式不需要在 PATH 中配置 `dsh`。终端用户可按 [桌面配套 CLI 的安装步骤](INSTALL.zh.md#桌面端命令行) 操作；npm 全局安装或 `npx` 启动的 CLI 不能管理 `desktop` profile。

使用启动该 Web 实例的同一套 DSH CLI，从 npm 安装到 `web` profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest
dsh web
```

如果 Web 进程已经在运行，先停止它，安装后再运行 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。以下命令均用于 Web。

也可以固定安装 0.2.11：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@0.2.11
dsh web
```

如果 PATH 中没有 `dsh`，可以使用同一个 CLI 包（固定宿主版本）：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 web
```

如果这个 profile 以前安装的是 GitHub 来源，可先尝试 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest`；若来源没有切换，先移除旧包再重新添加。

**0.2.10** 包含设置界面、会话搜索接入及依赖安全更新，不改变账号的订阅权限。配额请求兼容模式默认关闭，仅影响额度查询；图片、编辑和视频仍默认关闭，首次开启需确认风险、保存并重启。宿主支持仍为 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.87.1`（Node 22/24），不支持旧 0.1 宿主线。完整变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

需要可复现的 Git 安装时，以下命令固定到审核提交；不带 SHA 的 `github:MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit` 跟随 `main`，不是可复现锚点：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit#0578aad2ac07a60e664ae9b4f185dca477aeb2fd
```

完整 SHA 会固定安装结果；npm 安装则默认跟随 `latest` 稳定版本。

打开 **设置 → xAI Grok**，完成登录后选择 `xai-oauth / grok-4.6` 或账号当前可见的其他主线 Grok 模型。已经保存在 dsh 设置中的模型仍有更高优先级。

完整的安装、迁移、卸载和故障处理步骤见 [INSTALL.zh.md](INSTALL.zh.md)。

- 模型选择器只展示主线 Grok 聊天模型；Imagine、video、embedding、build/code 变体会被隐藏
- 默认 grok-4.6 描述符使用 high reasoning，并请求 `reasoning.encrypted_content`，以便后续回合带回加密推理上下文
- `grok_imagine`（文生图）与 `grok_imagine_edit`（图生图，复用主 OAuth session）默认关闭，需在设置页确认风险后开启。图片保存到 DSH 附件库并在会话图片卡片中直接渲染。可从卡片下载，或使用宿主文件工具导出；两工具的 `save_path` 参数均不再支持直接写盘
- dsh 原生 `web_search` 仍保留在宿主工具列表中，但会从启用 backend search 的 xAI payload 中移除，避免工具重名

模型列表来自登录账号的 `GET /v1/models` 结果，并在本地缓存。服务端能力或模型要求发生变化时，仍可能需要更新插件；不会把“模型 id 可见”等同于“所有能力一定可用”。

- 本地图片路径：通过宿主文件系统（fs）有界读取，按实际宿主环境文件权限读取文件，受单图体积上限约束。运行卡片显示文件路径和“打开输入图片”入口；前端无法直接读取任意本地路径。
- 用户上传图片：DSH 将上传内容保存为会话附件。把宿主提供的完整 `attachment={...}` 引用传给 `grok_imagine_edit.image`；卡片通过会话 `readAttachment` 加载缩略图。
- 生成图片再编辑：工具结果包含 ImageBlock 和完整 `attachment={...}` 文本。将完整引用作为下一次 `image` 参数，附件服务会读取并验证保存后的图片并保留其归一化 metadata。
- 裸 `attachmentId=sha256:...` 仅在宿主附件库提供 `imageHostPath` 时支持；远程附件后端应使用完整引用。附件 ID 不是本地文件路径或 URL。
- data URI 输入经过解码大小、base64、图片签名和 MIME 一致性校验；远程 URL 由上游获取，卡片显示链接，避免浏览器自动请求任意远程地址。
- 会话卡片交互：运行卡片显示提示词和全部输入来源；图片完成后显示结果、下载入口与再次生成/编辑入口。再次编辑会保留全部输入图和原调用的渲染参数。

提供单图生视频、持久任务恢复与账号隔离下载，对应 `grok_video_generate` / `grok_video_status` / `grok_video_resume`，默认关闭。设置页的「媒体与任务」页会显示本地能力状态和任务列表。开启需要确认风险并重启 DSH；生成会消耗订阅额度，“停止等待”只是不再等待，不会取消已提交的任务。用法、配置及限制见 [视频说明](VIDEO.zh.md)。

readme.section: 媒体工具的开启与风险
readme.text:
图片、图片编辑和视频默认都是关闭的。打开 **设置 → xAI Grok →「媒体与任务」**，拨动开关后卡片里会出现风险确认：确认并保存，重启 DSH 宿主后工具生效；取消或不动，就不会有任何改变。图片开关同时控制生成和编辑，两项状态分开显示。正常使用（生成、再编辑、查询、下载）不会再弹确认；关闭后重新开启时才会再问一次。开启只保存设置，不生成媒体，也不探测额度。

先把几件事说清楚：这是第三方非官方接入，能否使用取决于 xAI 的账户资格和服务规则，随时可能被限制或暂停；生成会消耗订阅额度或产生费用；提示词和输入图片都会上传给 xAI，请不要发送敏感内容或无权使用的素材；“停止”只是停止等待，不会取消已提交的任务。

readme.section: 媒体工具的开启与风险
readme.text: 未确认的旧媒体开启值不生效，首次使用需明确确认；已确认的选择会持久保存，升级或重启不会重置。想分别控制 `imagineTool` / `editTool` / `videoTool`，可以在配置里显式设置并加上 `mediaRiskAcknowledged: true`——这只是本机的知情开关，不是凭据，也不代表官方许可。重置媒体页会撤销确认；关闭并保存后工具立即停止响应调用（已提交的任务不受影响），视频关闭时本地任务列表、恢复和下载接口一并停用，已有任务和附件保留。

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backendSearch` | `false`（默认关闭；设置页可打开） | 在主聊天请求中启用 xAI 服务端网页/X 搜索 |
| `nestedSearchTools` | 省略时取 `!backendSearch` | 注册独立的 `grok_web_search` / `x_search` |
| `statefulResponses` | 省略时 `false` | 显式打开才用 `store` + `previous_response_id`；`toolUse` 回合不续链 |
| `searchModel` | `grok-build-0.1` | 嵌套搜索模式使用的模型 |
| `searchMaxResults` | `8` | 嵌套搜索返回来源的上限 |
| `webSearchTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 嵌套网页搜索的协作式超时预算 |
| `xSearchTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 嵌套 X 搜索的协作式超时预算 |
| `imagineTool` | `false` | 确认媒体风险后注册 `grok_imagine`（文生图） |
| `editTool` | `false` | 确认媒体风险后注册 `grok_imagine_edit`（高级配置可独立于 `imagineTool`，设置页图片开关控制两项） |
| `videoTool` | `false` | 确认媒体风险后注册视频生成、查询和恢复工具 |
| `videoModel` | `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | 视频生成模型（实验性，只读展示；当前仅接受这一个值） |
| `videoMaxBytes` | `104857600` | 视频下载大小上限（字节，默认 100 MiB；只读展示） |
| `mediaRiskAcknowledged` | `false` | 显式确认上述媒体风险；需与所选媒体开关均为 `true` 才启用 |
| `editModel` | `''` | 固定图生图模型；为空时跟随线上目录自动选择（优先 `grok-imagine-image-2.0`，fallback `grok-imagine-image`） |
| `editMaxSourceImages` | `5` | `grok_imagine_edit` 单次请求源图片上限，插件最多接受 5 张 |
| `editMaxImageBytes` | `20971520` | `grok_imagine_edit` 单张源图片体积上限（默认 20 MiB） |
| `proxyUrl` | `''` | xAI 专用 HTTP/H

本 bundle 的组合默认值来自 `cordis.patch.yml`。手工拆分或重组配置时，可用 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 核对最终值。

设置页 → xAI Grok →「搜索与对话」或「媒体与任务」可分别覆盖相关搜索/功能键；保存和重置只影响当前页，切页保留草稿（保存后重启生效；未修改的键继续跟随组合默认值，不会固化）。「网络」页的 `proxyUrl` 保存即生效。路线与后续候选见 [路线文档](ROADMAP.zh.md)。

「网络」页另有默认关闭的 **配额请求兼容模式**。若登录、聊天正常但额度读取因全局 `fetch` 包装链冲突而超时，可开启此项并保存：仅额度请求改用插件专用通道，每次请求动态使用当前 xAI 代理，不影响聊天和登录；代理留空时专用通道明确直连，不跟随宿主的全局 `fetch` 或全局 dispatcher。开关与代理地址一起保存后立即生效，无需重启，并清除旧配额缓存。页面显示实际生效的地址（含配置/环境变量回退），保存会将该地址作为插件存储覆盖，优先于配置/环境变量。凭据目的地、禁止重定向、超时/取消和账号隔离保护不变；此模式不保证解决所有插件组合的网络故障。

**出口控制提醒：依赖宿主级强制出口、DLP 或强制网络包装的环境不要开启兼容模式。** 若只需要固定出口代理，请同时填写插件代理 URL；这不能恢复被绕过的宿主控制。兼容通道只接受三条固定的官方额度端点，不是通用网络出口。网络设置初次加载失败时，可点击“重试加载网络设置”；重试保留未保存草稿，加载成功前仍禁止保存。

readme.section: 登录文件、代理与安全边界
readme.text:
- 优先使用 `~/.grok/auth.json`，与 Grok CLI 原地共用同一份 xAI 凭据；登录和刷新都会写回该文件，而不是只做一次性导入；在设置页退出也会让 Grok CLI 退出
- OAuth 刷新令牌会轮换；插件用原子写入、进程内合并和 compare-and-write 避免并发刷新互相覆盖
- 浏览器状态接口、错误信息和诊断不会返回 token 值
- OAuth access token 只发送到 HTTPS 的 `api.x.ai`、`cli-chat-proxy.grok.com`，以及 `https://grok.com/grok_api_v2.GrokBuildBilling/GetGrokCreditsConfig` 这一条额度 URL。带 Authorization 的请求拒绝重定向，包括聊天 SDK 发出的实际请求；此检查不扩展为允许任意 `x.ai` 子域名。OAuth 设备码授权与令牌刷新的表单请求，以及不带 token 的视频下载仍走各自原有流程。
- 插件接口只接受本机回环连接与回环 Host，并校验浏览器来源。桌面端的 `dsh-app://app` 页面受信任；没有 Origin、但携带 Fetch Metadata 的本机请求也可写入设置。该标记不是桌面身份或权限证明：本插件不隔离本机进程或桌面渲染器。不要将接口暴露到局域网或公网，也不要在不可信的多用户环境共享凭据目录。
- 代理只接受不含用户名/密码的 `http://` 或 `https://` URL；带 userinfo 的旧值会被清理，不会进入状态响应或日志
- 代理通过同一 DSH 进程的全局 `fetch` hook 按目标分流：匹配 `x.ai`、其子域名、`cli-chat-proxy.grok.com`，以及 `grok.com` 上精确的 `GetGrokCreditsConfig` 额度回退路径。因此也会影响其他组件通过该 hook 发往这些地址的请求。`grok.com` 的其他路径和其他请求交给原有 `fetch` 处理，不强制直连；插件卸载时恢复 hook，不永久修改系统或进程环境变量。同一 OAuth bearer 在额度回退时也会发往 `grok.com`。
- Windows 上的 Node mode bit 不等于 NTFS ACL；如果用户目录或 `$DSH_HOME` 位于共享位置，请自行收紧目录权限
- 凭据写入的锁委托官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write`（锁文件 `$DSH_HOME/.xai-oauth-auth.json.lock`）。同一台机器、同一 PID 命名空间内，后来者可以用独占 claim 文件加二次存活性检查，接管并回收确认已退出的进程留下的锁；对方还活着、

- 当前支持矩阵冻结为：DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` + `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.87.1`（Node 22/24）。不再宣称兼容旧 0.1 宿主线。
- 某些订阅档位可能允许浏览器登录，却对聊天或服务端搜索返回 HTTP 403；这是账户资格/服务策略问题，不等同于 token 过期
- HTTP 401 会在串行刷新后重试一次；403 不会按 token 过期处理
- 不支持与另一个注册相同 xAI OAuth 路由的 bundle 同时安装；请先按 [INSTALL.zh.md](INSTALL.zh.md) 的迁移步骤移除冲突 bundle
- backend search 默认关闭，可在设置页或配置中开启；可用性仍由账号、模型和 xAI 当前服务决定
- 删除插件不会自动删除 `~/.grok/auth.json`；需要清理本地登录时，请先在设置页退出

**启动或聊天报 `timed out waiting for the writer lock`**：某次异常退出的写入进程遗留了未被自动回收的锁（如活进程占用、非规范锁、权限异常，或崩溃遗留的 `.takeover-*` claim 文件）。插件委托官方协议安全接管已退出进程的锁，但为避免误删活跃写入者的锁，活锁与无法验证的锁不会盲目清理。请按以下步骤手动排查：

1. 关闭所有 DeepSeek Harness 与 Grok CLI 进程，并通过系统进程列表确认已无相关运行中的后台进程；
2. 确认进程完全停止后，删除 `$DSH_HOME`（默认 `~/.dsh`）下的 `.xai-oauth-auth.json.lock` 以及可能残留的 `.xai-oauth-auth.json.lock.takeover-*` claim 文件；
3. `~/.grok/auth.json.lock` 属于 Grok CLI，仅在确认 Grok CLI 完全退出后删除；
4. 重新启动。
启动时的目录刷新失败（含上述锁超时）不会阻断聊天：插件先用缓存的模型列表，并在后台按 5s / 30s / 120s 退避重试。

欢迎通过 issue 反馈问题、提出建议，也欢迎通过 PR 参与改进。拥有有效 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅的用户可以按 [live-testing 模板](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit/issues/new?template=live-testing.md) 开 issue，逐项记录聊天、连续对话、工具调用、搜索与 Imagine 的通过 / 失败 / 未测状态，并附上插件版本、`dsh --version`、Node 版本、操作系统、订阅档位（按官方原文）、测试日期和最小复现步骤。提交前先脱敏：不要粘贴 token、`auth.json` 内容、账号邮箱、session id、私有路径或私密对话内容。

提交前请先搜索[现有 issue](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit/issues)，有相同问题时把结果补充到原 issue，不要重复开帖。不要仅为测试续订订阅，也不必覆盖每一个可选功能；单次会话中一项或几项的真实结果同样有价值。

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-grok-kit
```

日常开发运行 `npm ci`（或 `npm install`）并使用 `npm run check` 即可完成类型检查、测试与构建。当需要在本地开发环境中链接真实宿主依赖进行调试时，可按需可选运行 `node scripts/link-host-deps.mjs`（非强制，避免误改用户本地 profile）。

CI 在 Node.js 22 与 24 上执行 frozen install、typecheck、测试、构建，并确认提交的 `lib/` 与源码构建结果一致。

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> Use Grok in DeepSeek Harness through OAuth: fused web/X search in the main model turn, reasoning continuity across turns, image generation and editing, video generation (experimental), and an xAI-only proxy.

`dsh-grok-kit` adds a separate `xai-oauth` route to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It does not require `XAI_API_KEY` or patch dsh source code. The point is not only to sign in, but to bring server-side search and the fields required for continuous reasoning into the main chat path.

- **Search in the main loop:** web and X lookup occurs inside Grok's current Think turn, so reasoning can use newly found material immediately
- **Continuous multi-turn reasoning:** high effort is the default, with `reasoning.encrypted_content` preserved for the next turn
- **Sign-in stays in sync with Grok CLI:** the plugin shares and writes back `~/.grok/auth.json` instead of copying once and rotating refresh tokens separately
- **Image generation and editing (experimental):** `grok_imagine` for text-to-image and `grok_imagine_edit` for image-to-image (reusing the main OAuth session), off by default and enabled after risk confirmation in Settings. Non-chat models stay out of the conversation picker
- **Session image cards:** generated and edited images are stored in the DSH attachment library and rendered in session cards showing the prompt, inputs, and result, with download and re-generate/re-edit actions
- **Video generation (experimental):** image-to-video with durable tasks, resume, and account-scoped downloads; off by default, enabled after risk confirmation and a DSH restart
Supporting behavior includes an xAI-only proxy, forced refresh and one retry on chat 401, atomic credential writes, a capability status page, and diagnostic redaction.

readme.section: The X Subscription and legacy plans
readme.text: **Sign in with Grok / X Subscription** uses the same official Grok OAuth flow for the X Subscription and legacy SuperGrok / X Premium plans. Signed-in users can reauthorize to switch accounts without first deleting shared credentials. The account page also links to the [official subscription dashboard](<https://grok.com/dashboard>).

readme.section: The X Subscription and legacy plans
readme.text: Quota comes from the official billing/settings responses: percentage, period, plan and prepaid balance. A missing REST percentage triggers one gRPC verification. Only a complete, successful response with a valid current period can yield the proto3 implicit zero: 0% used / 100% remaining. Otherwise subscription details remain visible with unknown usage, never unlimited usage. Verification has its own short timeout, so its failure or timeout preserves already-read partial details; the whole-get deadline, cancellation and account checks still apply. Results are cached per account for at most 60 seconds; verified usage does not remain cached beyond its valid period, and the period is rechecked before returning it. An uncached read missing a percentage adds at most one gRPC request, and REST 429 never triggers it. Current-period checks rely on the local clock; clock skew can affect freshness and implicit-zero decisions. Unified billing is identified by the reported flag, not guessed from the plan name. Only the signed-in identity is shown; workspaces and seats are not aggregated. The plugin does not provide Cursor sign-in or integrations for other models or external agents.

readme.section: The X Subscription and legacy plans
readme.text: **0.2.11** adapts the sidebar icon to the native DSH 0.2.2 slot, retaining the five-tab settings UI and per-session fused-search interface. Account handling and media risk confirmations are unchanged. Reload the plugin or restart DSH after updating.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text: The same model id does not guarantee the same experience across integrations. [xAI documents that `grok-4.6` is available in both Grok Build and the public API](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview); the important search difference is whether server-side tools share the main conversation request.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text: **Separate search** sends another model request to retrieve or summarize material before returning it to the main conversation. That path remains useful when explicit filters are needed, but adds another model round, and its search summary is not produced inside the current reply's Think turn.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text: **Main-turn search** follows [xAI's server-side Responses search pattern](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/web-search), placing `{type:web_search}` and `{type:x_search}` directly on the main Grok request. Lookup occurs inside Think, so the model can use newly found web and X material during the same reasoning turn. This path is off by default (since v0.1.8); enable it from Settings or config.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text:
To let both search systems coexist, DSH's native `web_search` remains in the host tool list but is removed from an xAI payload with fused search enabled, preventing a server-tool name collision. Other model routes can continue using the host search tool normally.

From 0.2.10, integrating plugins can set search on or off for individual sessions, overriding global `backendSearch` in either direction. Unbound DSH sessions keep the global setting. The integrating plugin must support this interface.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text:
> When main-turn search is on, the plugin strips xAI reject stubs such as `x_keyword_search` so DSH does not start another step and reprint the writeup. If those names still appear, treat them as a diagnostic path, not normal UI.

For domain, account, or date filters, use the standalone `grok_web_search` / `x_search` tools — the default path while `backendSearch` is off; enabling `backendSearch` turns this standalone path into the optional mode.

readme.section: Search in the main model turn
readme.text: `statefulResponses` is off by default. When enabled, the plugin uses `store: true` and `previous_response_id` to continue the conversation, appending only new user messages. It does not continue a turn that used client tools such as bash, to avoid repeating an existing search answer. Continuing a conversation does not guarantee that all search material from the previous turn is cached.
A real text-to-image result, displayed directly in a session card. View it at full size, download it, copy the image or prompt, or generate it again.

Video results use the same card layout. Image generation, editing, and video are experimental and off by default; enable them in Settings after confirming the risks. Availability depends on account eligibility and service-side restrictions.
The settings UI in 0.2.10 has five tabs: Account, Models, Search, Media, and Network.
The account page brings subscription usage and balance together, with a manual quota refresh. The values reflect this account at capture time, not the quota or plan available to every account.
Control Web / X search within the same reply and continuous conversation separately. Both are experimental and off by default; fused search was manually enabled in this screenshot.

The image switch controls generation and editing together and shows both current states; video has its own setting. All media features are experimental and off by default, requiring risk confirmation to enable. Video also requires a DSH restart, and availability depends on account eligibility and service-side restrictions.

readme.section: Web search inside the main loop
readme.text: No nested search-tool card is opened: web lookup occurs inside the same Think turn, and the material is used immediately by the current reply. The news content is illustrative UI data, not a factual reference.
Desktop and Web have separate plugin installations and activation states. Choose the client you use; installing into the Web profile does not install the plugin into Desktop.

1. Open the desktop app and select **Plugins → Add plugin** in the sidebar.
2. Enter `dsh-grok-kit@latest` and install it, or use `dsh-grok-kit@0.2.11` to pin this release.
3. Click **Enable now** when installation finishes. If prompted to restart, fully quit through the application menu or tray **Quit** action, then reopen the app. Closing the window may only hide it.
4. Check that **Settings → xAI Grok** is available, then sign in with an eligible account.

This route does not require `dsh` on PATH. For terminal installation, follow the [desktop-bundled CLI steps](INSTALL.md#desktop-cli). An npm-installed or `npx` CLI cannot manage the `desktop` profile.

Use the same DSH CLI that starts your Web instance to install into its `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest
dsh web
```

If the Web process is already running, stop it first, then run `dsh web` after installation and refresh the page. The commands below are for Web.

You can also pin version 0.2.11:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@0.2.11
dsh web
```

If `dsh` is not on PATH, run the same CLI package through `npx` (pinned to the supported host version):

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 web
```

If this profile previously used the GitHub source, first try `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-kit@latest`. If the source does not switch, remove the old package and add it again.

**0.2.10** updates settings, per-session search integration, and dependency security without changing subscription entitlements. Quota request compatibility mode is off by default and affects quota reads only. Image generation, editing, and video remain off by default; first-time enablement requires risk confirmation, saving, and a restart. Host support remains DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.87.1` (Node 22/24); the legacy 0.1 host line is unsupported. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the full update notes.

For a reproducible Git install, the command below pins a reviewed commit. `github:MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit` without a SHA follows `main` and is not a reproducible pin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit#0578aad2ac07a60e664ae9b4f185dca477aeb2fd
```

The full SHA fixes the installed source; the npm form follows the stable `latest` release by default.

Open **Settings → xAI Grok**, finish sign-in, then choose `xai-oauth / grok-4.6` or another mainline Grok model currently visible to the account. A model already saved in dsh settings still takes precedence.

See [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for installation, migration, removal, and troubleshooting details.

- The picker shows only mainline Grok chat models; Imagine, video, embedding, build, and code variants are hidden
- The default grok-4.6 descriptor uses high reasoning and requests `reasoning.encrypted_content` so encrypted reasoning context can be carried into later turns
- `grok_imagine` (text-to-image) and `grok_imagine_edit` (image-to-image, reusing the main OAuth session) are off by default and require risk confirmation in Settings to enable. Images are stored in the DSH attachment library and rendered directly in session image cards. Images can be downloaded from the card or exported with host file tools; direct disk writing via `save_path` is no longer supported for either tool
- DSH's native `web_search` remains in the host tool list, but is removed from an xAI payload with backend search enabled to avoid duplicate tool names

The model list comes from the signed-in account's `GET /v1/models` response and is cached locally. Service or model requirements may still require a plugin update; a visible model id does not imply that every capability is available to the account.

- Local image paths: read boundedly via host filesystem (fs) services according to the host environment permissions, subject to single-image size caps. The execution card shows the path and an "open input image" entry; frontends cannot read arbitrary local paths directly.
- User-uploaded images: saved by DSH as session attachments. Pass the full `attachment={...}` reference provided by the host to `grok_imagine_edit.image`; the card loads thumbnails via session `readAttachment`.
- Iterative editing of generated images: tool results include an ImageBlock and the full `attachment={...}` payload. Pass the full reference as the next `image` parameter; the attachment service reads and verifies the saved image while preserving normalized metadata.
- Bare `attachmentId=sha256:...` handles are supported only when the host attachment library provides `imageHostPath`; remote attachment backends must use the full reference. Attachment IDs are not local file paths or URLs.
- Data URI inputs are validated for decoded byte size, base64 encoding, magic-byte signatures, and MIME consistency; remote URLs are fetched upstream, and the card displays links to avoid automatic browser requests to arbitr

Provides image-to-video, durable task recovery, and account-scoped downloads via `grok_video_generate` / `grok_video_status` / `grok_video_resume`, all off by default. The "Media & tasks" settings page shows local capability observations and the task list. Enabling requires the risk confirmation and a DSH restart; generation consumes subscription usage, and stopping the wait only stops waiting — it does not cancel a submitted job. See the [video guide](VIDEO.md) for configuration and limitations.

readme.section: Enabling media tools and understanding the risks
readme.text: Image generation, image editing, and video are all off by default. In DeepSeek Harness Settings → xAI Grok → "Media & tasks", flipping a switch opens an inline risk confirmation inside the card: confirm and save, then restart the DSH host to register the tools; cancel or ignore it, and nothing changes. The image switch controls generation and editing together, with each state shown separately. Normal use — generating, re-editing, queries, downloads — does not ask again; only reopening after a close does. Enabling saves settings only, without generating media or probing quota.

readme.section: Enabling media tools and understanding the risks
readme.text: A few things to know up front: this is third-party, unofficial access. Whether it works depends on your xAI account eligibility and xAI service rules, and access can be limited or paused at any time. Generation uses subscription quota or incurs charges. Prompts and input images are uploaded to xAI — do not send sensitive content or material you have no rights to. "Stop" in the UI only stops waiting; it does not cancel a submitted task.

readme.section: Enabling media tools and understanding the risks
readme.text: Legacy media enablement without acknowledgment stays inactive; confirm explicitly before first use. Acknowledged choices persist across upgrades and restarts. To control `imagineTool`, `editTool`, and `videoTool` separately, set them explicitly in config together with `mediaRiskAcknowledged: true` — a local informed choice, not a credential or permission. Resetting Media & tasks revokes consent. Saving a close stops the tools from answering calls immediately (submitted jobs are unaffected); with video off, its local task list, resume, and download routes are disabled too, and existing tasks and attachments stay stored.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backendSearch` | `false` (off by default; enable from Settings) | Enable xAI server-side web/X search in the main chat request |
| `nestedSearchTools` | omitted: `!backendSearch` | Register separate `grok_web_search` / `x_search` tools |
| `statefulResponses` | omitted: `false` | Opt-in `store` + `previous_response_id`; `toolUse` turns are not continued |
| `searchModel` | `grok-build-0.1` | Model used by nested search mode |
| `searchMaxResults` | `8` | Maximum number of sources returned by nested search |
| `webSearchTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Cooperative budget for nested web search |
| `xSearchTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Cooperative budget for nested X search |
| `imagineTool` | `false` | Register `grok_imagine` (text-to-image) after media risk confirmation |
| `editTool` | `false` | Register `grok_imagine_edit` after media risk confirmation (independent advanced config; the Settings image switch controls both tools) |
| `videoTool` | `false` | Register video generation, status and resume tools after media risk confirmation |
| `videoModel` | `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Video generation model (experimental, read-only display; currently
The bundle defaults come from `cordis.patch.yml`. For a manually reduced or recomposed setup, inspect the final values with `dsh --profile web --dump-config`.

Settings split related keys between Search & conversation and Media & tasks. Saves/resets apply only to the current page and drafts survive page switches (restart to apply; untouched keys still follow the bundle defaults). `proxyUrl` on Network applies immediately on save. See the [roadmap](ROADMAP.zh.md) for delivery status and future candidates.

Network also offers **Quota request compatibility mode**, off by default. If sign-in and chat work but quota reads time out because of a global `fetch` wrapper conflict, enable it and save: only quota requests use a plugin-owned channel, reading the current xAI proxy on every call. Chat and sign-in are unchanged. A blank proxy explicitly connects this channel directly, without the host's global `fetch` or global dispatcher. The mode and URL are saved together, take effect immediately without a restart, and invalidate the old quota cache. The page shows the effective URL, including config/environment fallback; saving persists that address as the plugin's stored override, ahead of config/environment values. Credential destinations, redirect refusal, timeouts/cancellation and account isolation remain enforced. This mode is not a guarantee against every multi-plugin networking conflict.

**Do not enable compatibility mode where host-level egress controls, DLP or mandatory outbound wrappers are required.** If you only need a fixed outbound proxy, also configure the plugin proxy URL; that does not restore the bypassed host controls. The compatibility channel accepts only the three fixed official quota endpoints, not arbitrary destinations. If network settings fail to load, use “Retry loading network settings”; retries preserve unsaved drafts and saving remains disabled until loading succeeds.

readme.section: Sign-in document, proxy, and security boundaries
readme.text:
- The live store prefers `~/.grok/auth.json`, sharing the same xAI credential with Grok CLI in place; sign-in and refresh write back to that file instead of performing a one-time import, and signing out in Settings signs Grok CLI out too
- OAuth refresh tokens rotate; atomic writes, in-process coalescing, and compare-and-write prevent concurrent refreshes from overwriting one another
- Browser status routes, errors, and diagnostics do not return token values
- OAuth access tokens are sent only over HTTPS to `api.x.ai`, `cli-chat-proxy.grok.com`, or the exact `https://grok.com/grok_api_v2.GrokBuildBilling/GetGrokCreditsConfig` quota URL. Requests carrying Authorization reject redirects, including actual chat-SDK requests; arbitrary `x.ai` subdomains are not permitted by this check. OAuth device-code/refresh form posts and token-free video downloads retain their separate existing flows.
- Plugin routes accept only loopback connections and loopback Host names, with browser-origin checks. The desktop `dsh-app://app` page is trusted; local requests without Origin but with Fetch Metadata may also write settings. This marker is not proof of desktop identity or authorization: the plugin do

- Supported host matrix is frozen at: DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` + `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.87.1` (Node 22/24). Compatibility with the legacy 0.1 host line is no longer claimed.
- Some subscription tiers may allow browser sign-in but return HTTP 403 for chat or server-side search; this is an entitlement/service-policy result, not necessarily an expired token
- HTTP 401 is retried once after serialized refresh; 403 is not treated as token expiry
- Running this bundle alongside another bundle that registers the same xAI OAuth route is unsupported; follow the migration steps in [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) and remove the conflicting bundle first
- Backend search is off by default and can be enabled from Settings or config; availability still depends on the account, selected model, and xAI's current service behavior
- Removing the plugin does not delete `~/.grok/auth.json`; sign out in Settings first if the local login should be removed

**Startup or chat reports `timed out waiting for the writer lock`**: An abnormally terminated write left a lock file that was not automatically reclaimed (such as a lock held by an active process, a malformed lock, permission issues, or a leftover `.takeover-*` claim file). The plugin relies on the official protocol for exited-process recovery, but active and unverified locks are never blindly removed to avoid stealing an active writer's lock. To resolve manually:
A failed startup catalog refresh (including the lock timeout above) never blocks chat: the plugin serves the cached model list and retries in the background with 5s / 30s / 120s backoff.

Issues with bug reports or suggestions and pull requests with improvements are welcome. Users with an active SuperGrok / X Premium subscription can open an issue with the [live-testing template](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit/issues/new?template=live-testing.md), recording pass / fail / untested for chat, follow-up chat, tools, search, and Imagine, plus the plugin version, `dsh --version`, Node version, OS, subscription tier (exact official wording), test date, and minimal reproduction steps. Redact before submitting: no tokens, no `auth.json` contents, no account email, no session ids, no private filesystem paths, no private conversation content.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit/issues) first; add results to a matching issue instead of opening a duplicate. Do not renew a subscription just to test, and partial results from a single session are still valuable.

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-grok-kit
```

Routine development uses `npm ci` (or `npm install`) and `npm run check` for full typechecks, tests, and builds. Running `node scripts/link-host-deps.mjs` is optional when linking live host dependencies for local debugging, and is not mandatory to avoid modifying user profiles unintentionally.
CI runs frozen install, typecheck, tests, and build on Node.js 22 and 24, then confirms that the committed `lib/` matches the source build.
